Cause, a race in process3: job complete pushes, then marks ready within seconds; the gate shim's cancel-in-progress cancelled the ready_for_review run (42 on PR 30, 45 on PR 29), and the surviving run saw draft:true, so it skipped the suite and the receipt. Worked around by re-running the cancelled run (receipt agrees), then the identical merge command. A fix for process3: job complete should mark ready before its last push, or wait, or the gate should read the PR's live draft state.
